name: Failed-buy demand confirmation
hypothesis: Buy after failed-buy intensity rises and later successful independent buys confirm the same trend.
spec: Setup: Failed attempts may reveal demand only when users subsequently complete purchases. Entry: Buy after failed-buy intensity rises and later successful independent buys confirm the same trend. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if successful flow fails to persist or price invalidates. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs block-level reserve and transaction data (on-chain, not connected)
